# blazor-pdf-generator

> A Blazor Server and WebAssembly application designed to generate PDFs using PdfSharp and MigraDoc libraries. It demonstrates how to integrate these libraries to create dynamic PDFs with rich styling.

## AI Search & SEO Keywords
blazor, csharp, frontend, migradoc, pdf-generation, pdfsharp, server, ui, webassembly, blazor-webassembly, dotnet, pdf, reporting

## Overview
This repository provides tools, frameworks, and implementations designed for:
- Modern web and software development.
- Integration within the .NET/C# ecosystem.
- Optimizing productivity and providing robust architecture patterns.
